steps: Replay via MCP conkay_solve {solver_id: multiphysics.couple, typed inputs from the reference case} (or solve.direct once SC-00 lands): {domainA: {length: 0.05, k: 200, rho: 2700, cp: 900, nodes: 10}, domainB: {length: 0.10, k: 15, rho: 8000, cp: 500, nodes: 20}, tempLeft: 100, tempRight: 20, dt: 1e7, tEnd: 5e7, tolerance: 1e-10}, target cht → PASS with the interface temperature within 1e-5 of the analytic steady value ≈ 97.108 and the steady flux q = 80/(0.05/200 + 0.10/15) ≈ 11566 W/m² — from the analytic steady state of the two-slab case, never from the solver's own output.

Coupling-discipline leg: per time step the Dirichlet–Neumann pair iterates from the step-start state until BOTH the temperature residual AND the exchanged flux are stationary (the flux criterion scaled to the temperature tolerance across A's first cell), then a closing sweep re-solves both sides with the final exchanged values so the served fields are mutually consistent; non-converged steps are counted and warned, never silent. Three shapes must never reappear (each caught and fixed by this build's own suite): an iteration re-solving from the previous iterate's field (silently advancing time once per iteration), a temperature-only criterion declaring convergence on a stale flux at steady state, and a one-step 'steady' premise ignoring the 1/(λ·dt) transient remainder. Every run also reports the partitioned-vs-monolithic deviation — a discretization measure at the interface control volume that shrinks under refinement. Thermo-elastic leg: free expansion by trapezoid integration of α(T − Tref), and the fully constrained stress σ = −E·α·(mean T − Tref), pinned on the textbook linear-profile integrals (α·L·50 for a 50 K mean rise; −E·α·50).

Engine-tier leg: target precice → NOT_COMPUTED requires_engine_tier:sxe-11 — full preCICE coupling between OpenFOAM / CalculiX / FEniCSx / Elmer is the engine tier's scope, refused by name, never approximated in JS; with the engine absent the engine path shows NOT_COMPUTED engine_unavailable:sxe-11 with install hint, never a fallback number labelled as the engine result; engine crash/timeout/non-convergence → engine_failed / engine_not_converged.

Adversarial: NaN / 1e300 / negative-where-physical-positive input (conductivities, lengths, densities, dt) → INVALID_INPUT with the field named; a missing required property → NOT_COMPUTED naming the field, no assumed value unless declared and echoed as defaulted (SC-03); a substituted input → NOT_COMPUTED input_substituted (inputs used == inputs submitted); a bare number on a dimensional input → refused unless the unit is declared (SC-04 leg, expected-fail until built).
